{{CharInfobox |color={{ghost color}} |corecolor={{ghost color light}} |bordercolor={{ghost color dark}} |name=Leader |jname=団長 |tmname=Leader |slogan=no |image=Leader JN014.png |size=250px |caption=Leader |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Black |gender=Male |region=[[Unova]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=JN014 |epname=Raid Battle in The Ruins! |enva=[[Sean Schemmel]] |java=[[Yasuhiro Mamiya]] }} The '''leader''' (Japanese: '''団長''' ''leader'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|JN}}. ==History== The leader of the ruins excavation team first appeared in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'' exploring the newly discovered [[Colossus Ruins]] at the [[Desert Resort]]. He joined {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], {{OBP|Kira|JN014}}, and [[Shane Seeker]] in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}, using his {{p|Litwick}} and {{p|Lampent}}. Eventually, the group defeated Golurk, and Goh subsequently caught it. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'' when Ash and Goh mistook the [[curator]] for him. In ''[[JN080|Trial on a Golden Scale!]]'', he showed Ash and Goh the {{p|Volcarona}} mural found at the Colossus Ruins. He was later seen in a fantasy in ''[[JN098|Out of Their Elements!]]'' and in another flashback in ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]''. ==Pokémon== This listing is of the excavation team leader's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Leader |pkmn=Litwick |type1=Ghost |type2=Fire |img=Leader Litwick.png |epnum=JN014 |epname=Raid Battle in The Ruins! |vajp= |vaen=Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld |desc={{p|Litwick}} is the leader's first known Pokémon. It was used in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}, but it retreated from the battle when Golurk simply repelled its attack. It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'' and ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]''. Litwick's only known move is {{m|Fire Spin}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Leader |pkmn=Lampent |type1=Ghost |type2=Fire |img=Leader Lampent.png |epnum=JN014 |epname=Raid Battle in The Ruins! |vajp= |vaen=Sean Schemmel |desc={{p|Lampent}} is the leader's second known Pokémon. It was used in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}, but it lost.
